Hahahahaha!! That's enough. Fall back, Garagaranda.

...Wh-What is this? I've never felt fear like this before...!!
Terror Dopant! But the plan isn't finished yet...!!
Garagaranda, there is no need to rush.

Indeed. I am the master of this Cube. But how unfortunate for you...
Draining the memories here is nearly complete. Besides, losing just one makes little difference.
What do you mean!? Are there other Gaia Gates!?
Hahahahaha!! Did you think there was only one Gaia Gate?
Countless Gaia Gates from all sorts of worlds have been drawn into this place. In other words...
I can access the "Earth's memories" of every one of those worlds.
Among them, I'm draining memories from the three Gaia Gates that remain nearly intact...
...and installing them into "Veda."
Veda!?
Veda!?
Veda!?
All so that, of every world, only what has value to Regis remains...
...and everything unnecessary is erased, you see?
...So that's the "Gaia Impact" you spoke of!!
Like hell... I'll let you do that!!
Something like that... I can't allow it!
I won't... let you do that...!!
I won't... let you do that...!!
I won't... let you do that...!!
I won't... let that happen!!
Like I'd... let you do that!!
I won't... let that happen!!
Y-You're just spoutin' whatever suits you!! I-I ain't lettin' you get away with it!!
I won't... let you do that...!!
I-I won't let you!!
I won't let you... do whatever you please!!
Like hell... I'll let you do that!!
Like hell... I'll let you do that!!

Impressive, that you could even stand before me, heroes! Now I'll show you what true terror is!!
Gwah...!! No good... I can't put any strength into my body!!

Gwah...!! My strength... I can't muster my strength...

notes.note: Leader blocks in this table follow the post-battle Pt_Chara_Check chain 4,1,13,11,12,14,15,5,3,2,6,7,8,9,10 = W, Rider 1, Taro, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero, OOO, Den-O, RX, Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, Wing Zero, 00 (key = TextIdOffset+n+1+k). #0.79-83 close the block begun at #0.69: Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, Wing Zero, 00. Wording checks out (Zero/Den-O/God Gundam slots are the rough/hot ones).
??? (CHARA_NAME 30) is Terror Dopant, unseen; Garagaranda names him in #0.102.

Block #0.86-100 per chain: W (Shotaro), Rider 1, Taro, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero, OOO, Den-O (Momotaros), RX, Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, Wing Zero, 00. 'Rikutsu ja naku' = gut feeling, rendered 'I can't explain it'.
'Watashi to shita koto ga, kono teido de' = self-reproach at being shaken; rendered 'How unlike me...'. Same wording in Taro/Ultraman/Seven slots.
Zeta (Kamille) says 'this feeling again', distinct from Nu's line; kept 'again'.
Block #0.104-118: W's slot (#0.104) has its own wording (no '!?', 'so it was you'), rendered 'all along'; #0.112 is Momotaros ('omee'), roughened.
'Hitotsu ushinatta tokoro de' = losing one (Gaia Gate); kept 'one' since Accel's next line draws the inference.

On the traced script path #0.125 is followed directly by #0.131-132; #0.126-130 are not called by this script (possibly cut or used by the NC06 copy of the table). #0.125 phrased to lead into either #0.126 or #0.131.
'Veda' = the Gundam 00 quantum computer; not in glossary. Speaker inferred as Terror Dopant continuing #0.125; #0.127-129 'Veda!?' unlabelled reactions (likely the Gundam 00 cast). Off script path.
Accel: 'kisama no iu Gaia Impact' rendered 'the "Gaia Impact" you spoke of'. Term is from story_102 (Taboo / Terror); not in glossary.

Block #0.134-148 per chain. 'Saseru ka' rendered with 'I' as subject (the leader speaking for themself). #0.142 Momotaros: 'tsugou no ii koto bakari' = saying only what's convenient for you; 'yurusanee' rendered 'I ain't lettin' you get away with it'.
'Yoku, watashi no mae ni tateta na' = mock praise that they could even stand before him (they are paralysed by fear).
Block #0.150-164 (continues into story_105): 'chikara ga hairanai' rendered 'can't muster (any) strength'; rough 'hairanee' variants (Zero, Den-O) use 'my strength's gone'.

report: 80/80 rows translated. Leader variants voiced by the script's post-battle Pt_Chara_Check chain (W, Rider 1, Taro, Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero, OOO, Den-O, RX, Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, Wing Zero, 00). Uncertain: #0.85 ??? = Terror Dopant; #0.126-129 off script path, speaker of #0.126 inferred as Terror, 'Veda!?' reactors unknown. Not in glossary: 'Veda', 'Gaia Impact', 'Earth's memories' (follows earlier English).
